# Branch Operations Performance Review

This document addresses critical areas for improvement within branch operations.

Key objectives include:

*   Optimizing teller performance based on recent audit findings.
*   Updating teller performance metrics to align with the 2026 strategic goals.
*   Urgently improving overall branch efficiency.
*   Investigating and monitoring customer wait times to ensure compliance with updated standards.
